notes.overview: 5.412 km, 15 turns. A stop-and-go, traction-heavy circuit with high thermal load on tyres and brakes -- lap time comes from smooth exits, not aggressive entries. Turns 1-4 and the final complex are the big braking zones; the T5-T7 esses reward rhythm and kerb use. GT3 punishes the rears (manage heat, smooth throttle); Hypercar rewards braking precision and patient hybrid deployment on exits. Common mistakes: over-attacking braking zones and triggering ABS, overheating the rears early, over-using kerbs, and rotating with throttle instead of brake and steering.

corners.1: Hardest braking of the lap into the right-hander; the brake marker is the end of the left-side fencing. Compromise entry slightly to set up a better T2 exit and avoid triggering ABS.
corners.2: Left flowing out of T1. Minimal steering, keep the car settled and set up for T3; don't fight for the T1 apex at its expense.
corners.3: Right closing the opening complex. Rotate the car and prioritise a clean, stable exit onto the run down to T4; the abrasive surface punishes wheelspin.
corners.4: Medium-speed right, easy to over-drive. Take a mid-apex then use full exit width; a consistent minimum speed matters more than entry speed here.
corners.5: Left opening the fast left-right-left sequence. Attack the kerbs and keep the car flowing; prioritise a good T7 entry over a perfect exit here.
corners.6: Right in the middle of the sequence. Light brake taps rather than full lifts; stay smooth so the change of direction into T7 stays settled.
corners.7: Left completing the sequence. Use the kerb, then position left on exit to set up the T8 hairpin braking zone.
corners.8: The hairpin: downhill braking, so brake earlier than instinct suggests. Rotate the car before throttle and stay off the exit kerb; feed torque patiently to protect the rear.
corners.9: Technical left, combined braking and turning. Early turn-in with a trail-brake; keep the exit stable and avoid aggressive kerb use into T10.
corners.10: Left continuing the technical section. Be patient on entry and keep the car balanced; a stable exit carries speed toward the final sector.
corners.11: Right braking around the 100 m marker with light inside-kerb use. Settle the car and set up the linked T12.
corners.12: Right with an early, controlled turn-in. Keep it tidy and progressive so you're positioned for the critical final corner.
corners.13: The lap-time-critical final right onto the pit straight. Late turn-in, progressive throttle only -- getting greedy magnifies mistakes and costs the whole straight.
